system.description: The Curse of Caine does not always fully repair your injuries. Whenever you heal an aggravated wound, make a Physical Test against a number of Traits equal to 5 plus the Health Levels of aggravated damage you suffered. On a failure, you regain the lost Health Levels but still bear visible signs of the damage — burned hair that never regrows, lasting scars, and so on. Visible damage may require you to take the Negative Trait Repugnant, and a failed test after unusually severe damage may cost you Physical or Social Traits at the Storyteller's discretion.
